_comment: Which narration recording is APPROVED for publication, per piece and language.
Key: articles/<slug>/<lang>.  Value: the voice slug, matching a folder under
tts-out/articles/<slug>/<lang>/<voice>/ and a name in VOICES in scripts/fish_tts.py.
scripts/stage-audio.cjs reads this by default and copies exactly these files
into public/audio, which then ships with every deploy. Adding a line here is
what publishes a recording; removing one unpublishes it (the page falls back
to browser speech, which always reads the current text).
